newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: BBK forecast to post $25 mln net in 1996.
newsitem.headline: BBK forecast to post $25 mln net in 1996.

text.p: Bank of Bahrain and Kuwait is forecast to post a 9.5 million dinar ($25 million) net profit in 1996, up 18 percent on a year earlier, a research firm said.

"We project that BBK's net profit (adjusted for donations and directors' remuneration) for the whole of 1996 would be around 9.5 million dinars, representing an increase of around 18 percent over 1995," Securities & Investment Research Company said.
Bahrain-based BBK is equally owned by financial institutions and investors in Bahrain and Kuwait.
It made a net profit of 8.3 million dinars in 1995, up from 7.5 million dinars in 1994.
